body: Implement the three Over/Under variants the user's strategy notes describe but the repo lacks: (1) ColdLossSetOverUnder - the bundled losing-digit share filter including the barrier digit (Over 3: 0-3 combined <37.5%; Under 7: 7-9 combined <20%), vs the shipped ColdTailOverUnder which checks watch digits individually and excludes the barrier; (2) RepeatDigitReversal - run of identical consecutive digits then bet the 80% contract away from them (low run -> Over 1, high run -> Under 8); (3) multi-tick duration (1-5 ticks) in Decision + harness settlement, which today is hard-coded to one tick. All digit strategies are algebraically closed at -5% EV (payout = 0.95/p measured at every barrier), so these are claim-killers to register and replay against real ticks, not candidates.
